outcome: cesarean section for nonreassuring fetal status
cohort: 503 singleton low-risk pregnancies with cephalic presentation between 37 and 40 weeks and 6 days of gestation with intact or ruptured membranes
finding: The frequency of nonreassuring fetal heart patterns and perinatal outcomes were not different between patients with oligohydramnios, borderline oligohydramnios, and normal amniotic fluid index.
